headline: FIA launches a new helpline for online fraud complaints across Pakistan

card.desc: Citizens can now report scams directly to FIA

reel.intro_voice: FIA ne online fraud ki shikayat ke liye nayi helpline shuru kar di hai.

segments.text: FIA ne **online fraud** ke liye nayi helpline shuru ki
segments.voice: Federal Investigation Agency ne online fraud ki shikayaton ke liye nayi helpline jari ki hai.

segments.text: Shehri ab **seedha call** kar ke scam report kar sakte hain
segments.voice: Ab shehri seedha call kar ke kisi bhi scam ki report kar sakte hain.

segments.text: Shikayat ke saath **screenshots** aur number zaroor dein
segments.voice: Shikayat karte waqt screenshots aur number zaroor dein.

reel.outro_question: Kya aap ke saath kabhi online fraud hua?

caption:
📞 FIA ki nayi helpline!

• Online fraud ki shikayat ab seedha FIA ko
• Screenshots aur number saath dein

Kya aap ke saath kabhi online fraud hua? Comment mein batayein 👇
